10.translation: The double backbone carries source positions. All reference features retain their original intervals, strands and segments. Feature labels share the stacking Position; independent primers and restriction sites use their own tables and layers. The centre gives identity and complete length.

14.translation: This source profile contains 9 features and 39 restriction-site records at 33 distinct positions, without independent reference-primer rows. ⟦shared:0⟧ retains the original candidate count; complete search results can be rebuilt through the generator. The displayed reference set is not sampled down to three sites.

17.translation: Prepared annotation, primer and site tables can go directly to independent layers. Sequence recognition is optional when the tables already exist. Full lengths and source units must be supplied independently.
